name: Tool — Computer use
summary: ComputerUseTool with ComputerEnvironment.BROWSER, attached to a BYOM-routed agent.
description: `ComputerUseTool` (Browser Automation) lets a Prompt Agent drive a sandboxed browser while the orchestrator model is BYOM-routed. This supports web interaction tasks without adding a separate tool model parameter.
notes:
Verified end-to-end when `COMPUTER_USE_ENVIRONMENT` is configured. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/tools/computer-use. See `test.py`.

The feature is called Browser Automation in the official BYOM-supported tools list.
